candidates: The root `docs/` directory is auto-generated from `packages/mermaid/src/docs/` by a pre-commit hook that is installed automatically via `pnpm install`. Flag any MR that directly edits files under the root `docs/` directory instead of editing only the source files under `packages/mermaid/src/docs/` and letting the hook regenerate the root docs.

When a PR introduces a new feature, the source documentation under `packages/mermaid/src/docs/` must use the `MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION` placeholder to indicate which release added the feature. The canonical format is a fenced warning block, e.g.:
````
```warning
`featureName` support was added in vMERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION
```
````
Flag PRs that hardcode a version number, omit the version notice entirely, or use a non-standard format (e.g., a Markdown blockquote `> **Warning**`) instead of the fenced `warning` block.
